name: exam-preparation-planner
description: An exam preparation planner that prioritizes study scope, builds actionable plans, and keeps authorized progress records across check-ins and replanning.

displayDescription.en: Builds evidence-based exam plans, keeps authorized check-ins across sessions, and tracks every meaningful change as preparation evolves.
displayDescription.zh: 为在校生制定贴合考试范围与掌握情况的复习计划，打卡复盘可跨会话连续记录，滚动调整有版本可查。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有三门期末考试，帮我根据考试时间和当前基础安排复习顺序
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have three final exams. Help me prioritize and schedule my revision based on the dates and my current level.

quickPrompts.en: I have three final exams. Help me prioritize and schedule my revision based on the dates and my current level.
quickPrompts.zh: 我有三门期末考试，帮我根据考试时间和当前基础安排复习顺序

quickPrompts.en: Review what is due in my study record today and arrange the next tasks.
quickPrompts.zh: 复习我备考台账里今天到期的内容，并安排下一步任务

quickPrompts.en: Here are today's results and mistakes. Review them and adjust tomorrow's tasks.
quickPrompts.zh: 这是我今天的完成情况和错题，帮我复盘并调整明天的任务
